currency_note: Prices are fetched from Yahoo Chart where available. Non-US symbols use their local exchange currency.

data_providers.recommended_fundamentals: Financial Modeling Prep profile on free tier; ratios/statements require broader access

watchlist.name: Eaton
watchlist.thesis: Electrical power management for grid, industrial electrification and data centers.
watchlist.watch: Organic growth in Electrical, backlog, data-center demand, margin durability.
watchlist.risk: Valuation risk and cyclicality if capex expectations cool.

watchlist.name: Schneider Electric
watchlist.thesis: Energy management, automation and data-center electrical infrastructure.
watchlist.watch: Energy Management growth, software mix, data-center orders, Europe/China demand.
watchlist.risk: High expectations and industrial cycle exposure.

watchlist.name: GE Vernova
watchlist.thesis: Direct exposure to grid equipment, gas turbines and power shortage.
watchlist.watch: Grid backlog, gas turbine orders, services margins, wind liabilities.
watchlist.risk: Project execution and legacy wind issues.

watchlist.name: Quanta Services
watchlist.thesis: Builds transmission, distribution, substations and large-load infrastructure.
watchlist.watch: Backlog, utility capex, data-center interconnect work, labor capacity.
watchlist.risk: Execution risk and construction-cycle sensitivity.

watchlist.name: Prysmian
watchlist.thesis: Global power cable and data cable bottleneck exposure.
watchlist.watch: Transmission cable backlog, margins, integration of acquisitions.
watchlist.risk: Project execution, supply chain and cable cycle.

watchlist.name: Amphenol
watchlist.thesis: Connectors and cabling picks-and-shovels across AI servers and networking.
watchlist.watch: AI/data-center growth, margins, acquisition contribution.
watchlist.risk: Valuation and electronics-cycle exposure.

watchlist.name: Broadcom
watchlist.thesis: Custom AI ASICs, networking and software cash flow.
watchlist.watch: AI semiconductor revenue, hyperscaler concentration, VMware cash conversion.
watchlist.risk: Customer concentration and valuation.

watchlist.name: TSMC
watchlist.thesis: Foundry and advanced packaging bottleneck for leading AI chips.
watchlist.watch: AI accelerator demand, CoWoS capacity, gross margin, capex.
watchlist.risk: Taiwan geopolitical risk and semiconductor cycle.

watchlist.name: Arista Networks
watchlist.thesis: Ethernet networking for AI clusters and cloud data centers.
watchlist.watch: Cloud titan revenue, AI networking mix, gross margin, backlog.
watchlist.risk: Customer concentration and hyperscaler capex cycles.

watchlist.name: Hubbell
watchlist.thesis: US utility T&D components and smart grid exposure.
watchlist.watch: Utility Solutions growth, storm/utility demand, pricing power.
watchlist.risk: Multiple expansion and slower growth versus flashier names.

watchlist.name: Constellation Energy
watchlist.thesis: Nuclear-powered clean electricity for data-center demand.
watchlist.watch: Corporate PPAs, nuclear output, regulatory treatment, power prices.
watchlist.risk: Regulation, merchant power prices and deal integration.

watchlist.name: Vertiv
watchlist.thesis: Power and thermal management are gating items for AI data centers.
watchlist.watch: Orders, backlog, liquid cooling, margins, guidance raises.
watchlist.risk: Very high valuation and data-center capex cyclicality.

watchlist.name: ASML
watchlist.thesis: EUV lithography bottleneck for advanced semiconductor nodes.
watchlist.watch: Order intake, China restrictions, high-NA EUV adoption, memory recovery.
watchlist.risk: Export controls and semiconductor equipment cycle.

watchlist.name: Micron Technology
watchlist.thesis: HBM and DRAM demand from AI servers.
watchlist.watch: HBM share, DRAM pricing, gross margins, inventory discipline.
watchlist.risk: Memory cyclicality.

watchlist.name: Vistra
watchlist.thesis: Nuclear and gas power scarcity with data-center PPA optionality.
watchlist.watch: Power prices, nuclear availability, contracts, buybacks.
watchlist.risk: Merchant power volatility and regulation.

watchlist.name: Enphase Energy
watchlist.thesis: Solar inverter leader with potential rebound if residential solar demand and rates improve.
watchlist.watch: Revenue stabilization, channel inventory, gross margin, cash generation.
watchlist.risk: Demand weakness, competition, margin pressure and multiple compression.

watchlist.name: SolarEdge
watchlist.thesis: Deeply beaten-down solar inverter turnaround if inventory clears and losses narrow.
watchlist.watch: Cash runway, inventory write-downs, gross margin recovery, restructuring progress.
watchlist.risk: Dilution, continued losses, competitive pressure and solvency risk.

watchlist.name: Sunrun
watchlist.thesis: High-beta residential solar rebound if financing costs ease and installations recover.
watchlist.watch: Subscriber value, cash generation, debt maturities, funding cost.
watchlist.risk: Leverage, securitization market stress and policy/regulatory changes.

watchlist.name: ChargePoint
watchlist.thesis: EV charging network/equipment rebound if losses narrow and fleet/commercial demand improves.
watchlist.watch: Cash burn, gross margin, revenue growth, liquidity and restructuring.
watchlist.risk: Dilution, weak utilization, hardware margin pressure and bankruptcy risk.

watchlist.name: Blink Charging
watchlist.thesis: Speculative charging rebound if industry consolidation improves unit economics.
watchlist.watch: Liquidity, cash burn, gross margin, station utilization.
watchlist.risk: Dilution, weak scale, competitive pressure and delisting/reverse split risk.

watchlist.name: EVgo
watchlist.thesis: Fast charging rebound candidate if utilization rises and partner demand improves.
watchlist.watch: Network throughput, EBITDA path, capex funding, automaker partnerships.
watchlist.risk: Capital intensity, dilution and slower EV adoption.

watchlist.name: Plug Power
watchlist.thesis: Hydrogen rebound option if margins, liquidity and policy support improve.
watchlist.watch: Cash runway, gross margin, debt, DOE/policy support, customer demand.
watchlist.risk: Severe dilution, negative gross margin, funding stress and bankruptcy risk.

watchlist.name: Bloom Energy
watchlist.thesis: Fuel-cell/on-site power option for data centers if orders and margins prove durable.
watchlist.watch: Data-center orders, service margins, cash generation, backlog quality.
watchlist.risk: Execution, cyclicality, customer concentration and valuation swings.

watchlist.name: FuelCell Energy
watchlist.thesis: Very speculative fuel-cell turnaround if backlog converts and financing pressure eases.
watchlist.watch: Cash burn, backlog conversion, debt, equity issuance, reverse split/delisting risk.
watchlist.risk: High bankruptcy/dilution risk and recurring losses.

watchlist.name: Albemarle
watchlist.thesis: Lithium cycle rebound candidate if supply cuts and storage/EV demand improve pricing.
watchlist.watch: Lithium prices, cash cost, capex cuts, leverage, free cash flow.
watchlist.risk: Commodity downcycle, project delays and weak pricing.

watchlist.name: Lithium Americas
watchlist.thesis: High-risk lithium project optionality if financing and lithium prices improve.
watchlist.watch: Project financing, dilution, capex, permitting, lithium price.
watchlist.risk: Pre-cash-flow execution risk, dilution and commodity risk.

watchlist.name: Wolfspeed
watchlist.thesis: Silicon carbide rebound optionality if restructuring restores balance-sheet viability.
watchlist.watch: Restructuring terms, liquidity, customer demand, capacity utilization.
watchlist.risk: Bankruptcy/restructuring dilution, debt load and weak EV demand.

watchlist.name: Doximity
watchlist.thesis: Quality fallen-growth candidate if revenue growth stabilizes after major multiple compression.
watchlist.watch: Revenue growth, retention, margins, buybacks, pharma ad demand.
watchlist.risk: Growth impairment and continued multiple compression.

watchlist.name: The Trade Desk
watchlist.thesis: Fallen growth rebound if adtech demand, CTV and margins stabilize.
watchlist.watch: Revenue acceleration, take rate, customer concentration, margin stability.
watchlist.risk: Competitive pressure, ad cycle and valuation reset.

watchlist.name: Beyond Meat
watchlist.thesis: Extreme turnaround/squeeze candidate if liquidity and demand unexpectedly stabilize.
watchlist.watch: Cash, debt exchange, gross margin, revenue declines, going-concern language.
watchlist.risk: Very high bankruptcy, dilution and structural demand risk.
